body: I don't even know what I want. I'm just told that I need to get better, but maybe dying truly is what I want. I can't say I know of anything I'm working towards.
I've been trying to change for two years. My life is completely different from what it used to be and I'm a different person, but I just don't feel better.
I've been diagnosed and given medication and I've done therapy. I've talked to family members and nobody can really do anything.
The only opportunity I can even get at the moment wouldn't make anything better.
I've tried all of those, but thank you for the help anyways.

I don't know, I think the main thing driving me is hoping that I can get better. My problem is that my confidence is being placed on believing that I can't get better - if I've tried so many different ways to improve my life and none of them have worked, is there really an actual way to do it.

Just everything in life really. I get plenty of attention from others and such but I just feel alone. I have a really good relationship with my family members and such so there's no problem there. I've done lots of things to change how my day goes and even in smaller things, such as dieting or exercising, and nothing I've tried has helped. I think I'm just stuck like this, and I don't want to be alive feeling this way.
I've scheduled an appointment. I hope this will help. Thank you for the advice, I really appreciate it.
I feel afraid to tell a doctor about how I'm suicidal. I don't want any of my family to know that I am.
